reentry_law: Trigger4 MUST refresh current F2 main, legal runtime ownership and current accepted subject identities immediately before execution. This handoff never licenses composition of stale source with newer runtime credit.
objective: Prove that the already accepted local Voice ASR plus TTS software path remains executable from prestaged artifacts while external network is independently unavailable at the sandbox namespace/runtime boundary; do not change Voice architecture or model family merely to make the discriminator pass.

reuse_exact_runtime_subjects_first.subject_law: If current accepted evidence has explicitly superseded one of these exact artifacts, stop and rebind through current admitted evidence; never silently substitute a new model or artifact.

execution_contract: Prestage all exact model/runtime/fixture artifacts before the promotion-bearing network-off phase.
Bind exact current F2 source SHA, executable/binary hashes, model hashes, fixture hashes and probe/harness hash before inference.
Enter a positively identified disposable VPS sandbox with external network disabled at namespace/container boundary using the current admitted VPS sandbox authority.
Before inference, independently verify the egress fence with one or more bounded expected-failure probes; a Python socket monkeypatch alone is insufficient.
Execute the local ASR runtime against an already admitted German fixture and record transcript plus exit status.
Execute the local TTS runtime against one fixed German utterance and record output PCM/WAV format, duration and SHA256 plus exit status.
Record external inference/API call count as zero and preserve the sandbox network-fence evidence in the same receipt lineage.
Do not require physical microphone, physical speaker, desktop session or human-heard output for this VPS-representable discriminator.
next_if_pass: Return one exact Trigger4 runtime result bound to semantic key 0d83f7d...; Trigger7 then advances depth-first to G2A_TRUE_PARTIAL_STREAMING_ASR without opening a new Voice authority.
next_if_not_pass: Classify failure first. Repair only evidence/infra harness defects for EVIDENCE_INVALID or INFRA_AUTH_TRANSPORT_QUOTA. Mutate product semantics only after an exact PRODUCT_NEGATIVE and only through current Trigger4 ownership.
